{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
The '''''Solar Wind''''' was a small hotel that was located in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Gadrin]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. The building was constructed using [[synthcrete]] and it had two floors. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the hotel was considered to be old and had not been cleaned for a long time. In circa [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Varin Teska]] took refuge at the ''Solar Wind'' after [[Death/Legends|murdering]] the [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Narl Gorjax]] and the [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance agents who were investigating Gorjax's death, tracked Teska to the hotel and confronted him.
